import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem mathd_algebra_101_strict (x : ℝ) : x ^ 2 - 5 * x - 4 < 10 ↔ x ∈ Set.Ioo (-2) 7 := by
  constructor
  · 
    intro h
    have h₁ : -2 < x := by
      by_contra h₁
      
      have h₂ : x ≤ -2 := by linarith
      have h₃ : x ^ 2 - 5 * x - 4 ≥ 10 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x + 2), sq_nonneg (x - 7)]
      linarith
    have h₂ : x < 7 := by
      by_contra h₂
      
      have h₃ : x ≥ 7 := by linarith
      have h₄ : x ^ 2 - 5 * x - 4 ≥ 10 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x + 2), sq_nonneg (x - 7)]
      linarith
    exact ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
  · 
    intro h
    have h₁ : -2 < x := h.1
    have h₂ : x < 7 := h.2
    have h₃ : x ^ 2 - 5 * x - 4 < 10 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x + 2), sq_nonneg (x - 7)]
    exact h₃

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem mathd_algebra_101_strict (x : ℝ) : x ^ 2 - 5 * x - 4 < 10 ↔ x ∈ Set.Ioo (-2) 7 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hprod : (x - 7) * (x + 2) < 0 := by
      nlinarith
  
    have hx_lower : -2 < x := by
      by_contra hnot
      have hxle : x ≤ -2 := le_of_not_gt hnot
      have h₁ : x - 7 ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have h₂ : x + 2 ≤ 0 := by linarith
      have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (x - 7) * (x + 2) :=
        mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos h₁ h₂
      linarith
  
    have hx_upper : x < 7 := by
      by_contra hnot
      have hxge : 7 ≤ x := le_of_not_gt hnot
      have h₁ : 0 ≤ x - 7 := by linarith
      have h₂ : 0 ≤ x + 2 := by linarith
      have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (x - 7) * (x + 2) :=
        mul_nonneg h₁ h₂
      linarith
  
    exact ⟨hx_lower, hx_upper⟩
  
  · intro hx
    have hx_lower : -2 < x := hx.1
    have hx_upper : x < 7 := hx.2
    have hprod : (x - 7) * (x + 2) < 0 := by
      apply mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos
      · linarith
      · linarith
    nlinarith

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem mathd_algebra_101_strict (x : ℝ) : x ^ 2 - 5 * x - 4 < 10 ↔ x ∈ Set.Ioo (-2) 7 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    change -2 < x ∧ x < 7
    constructor
    · by_contra hx
      have hx' : x ≤ -2 := le_of_not_gt hx
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x + 2)]
    · by_contra hx
      have hx' : 7 ≤ x := le_of_not_gt hx
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - 7)]
  · intro h
    change -2 < x ∧ x < 7 at h
    rcases h with ⟨hx₁, hx₂⟩
    nlinarith
